_evidence: Record behind ebx for 0x00416bbb: dword +0x1c (abs, signed max with the floor [0x603498]) and the vector dwords +0x18/+0x40 (imul squares summed with add/adc, 64-bit root by the accepted 0x40113f, then 'idiv ebp' of (-x18<<22) and (x40<<22) by the root (1 when zero) - |x| <= root so the quotient fits for every pattern, including roots >= 2^31 seen as negative divisors - and 'div ebp' of |root|<<18 by the bound or by (|root|>>14)+1, which always exceeds the high dword). Every bit pattern is valid (both earlier distributions ran 200/200); the value lists make the coverage cases occur together: both vector dwords zero (root 0 -> ebp=1), huge pairs (0x80000000/0x7fffffff/+-0x40000000: root >= 2^31, the 'neg' block), small and large +0x1c (abs block, the floor taking over, bound <= |root|>>14 and the 0x400000 clamp). Writes go to +0x17c..+0x18c and +0x2ac (buffer 0x2b4).
